Why Chameleons Change Color? — Everyone thinks chameleons only match leaves to hide—turns out they flash mood lights!
Kids science answer for "why chameleons change color for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Chameleons mostly shift skin nanocrystals to control body temperature and signal moods like excitement, anger, or sunshine warmth.
